candidates.name: Freshwater Lake
candidates.reason: Southwestern/southern shoreline is overprinted by residence lettering and road-adjacent geometry. Historical northern hook is not straightforwardly continuous with the modern pond/basin subdivision. No complete shared outer-basin definition was established.

candidates.name: Duncan Brook/Black Brook
candidates.reason: Historical junction is clear, but modern unnamed tributaries and opposite-bank river junctions need a broader drainage trace to establish which exact north tributary represents Duncan Brook. Nearby affine-predicted vertex is not adopted as identity evidence.
